Creates a vector of squares over a las file, with the number of points of each return and their density in each square.

**Toolbox folder:** Lesto › utilities<br>
**Status:** Draft<br>
**Keywords:** las, density, vector<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello, Silvia Franceschi<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.lesto.modules.utilities.LasPointDensityExtractor`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inFile` | LAS file |  |  | Las file path. |
| `pGridStep` | double | m | `1.0` | The size of the square cells of the grid, starting from the south-west corner of the data. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outFile` | output file |  | The output squares of the grid that have points, with the count of the points of each return (imp1 to imp5), their total and their density in points per square unit. |
